subject: Private VPC/on-prem architecture review — next steps

Subject: Private VPC/on-prem architecture review — next steps

Hi Sam / Priya —

Great to meet you both earlier — thanks for the time and for walking us through the Acme Analytics use case. Quick recap from the discovery: you’re prioritizing low-latency inference for customer-facing queries (<= 150ms p95), strict data residency in our US VPC, and SOC2-aligned auditability. You mentioned potential on-prem for a subset of workloads and a desire to understand network requirements and authentication flows.

Next step: we’d like to schedule a technical architecture review (Private / VPC / on-prem deep dive) with our solutions team to align on the network, IAM, and deployment options. Proposed 60–90 minute slots (PDT):
- Tue Aug 15 — 10:00–11:30am PDT
- Wed Aug 16 — 2:00–3:30pm PDT

Please let me know which works best and who from your side should join (IT/networking, security, and the engineer who owns the on-prem infra would be ideal). I’m looping in Aditya (AE) and Nikhil (Solutions Architect) so they can lead the technical portion.

I’ve attached a draft agenda and a short architecture checklist (redwood-private-arch-draft.pdf) — if you already have a network diagram, please share it before the call.

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0123

Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks — I’ll be the technical lead on the call and will run through network/topology, firewall rules, outbound egress patterns, certs/KMS integration, and our recommended deployment options (hosted VPC vs dedicated nodes vs on-prem connector).

Draft agenda I suggest (attached):
1) Introductions & goals (5 min)
2) Current infra overview (Acme) — Priya/Rohan (10–15 min)
3) Redwood deployment options & tradeoffs (15–20 min)
4) Network connectivity requirements & firewall/egress details (20 min)
5) IAM/KMS/cert rotation and audit logs (10–15 min)
6) Next steps / mutual action items (10 min)

Prep items from your side: current network diagram, existing firewall rules (high level), and the list of services that need to reach our endpoints (IPs/domains). If you use a managed firewall vendor (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortinet), please flag that — it helps us prepare concrete guidance.

Proposed confirmed time: Wed, Aug 16 14:00–15:30 PDT — I’ll block 90 minutes. I’ve attached the draft agenda (redwood-private-arch-draft.pdf).

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
